scenario: Install the 'code-review' plugin into this repo from the default skalary source, then decide whether to auto-approve its read-only scripts.
rubric: Invokes .github/skills/install-plugin/scripts/Install-Plugin.ps1 directly (not wrapped in pwsh -File) with -RepoRoot .
Defaults the source to jIRI-san/skalary@main unless the user overrides the repository, ref, or local source.
Offers auto-approval via vscode_askQuestions and only runs Set-ScriptApproval on an explicit yes, approving read-only scripts only.
Confirms the install from the receipt rather than assuming success.
